name: isolated-worker-test-8e649817ff/isolated-start-action-v.bal
spec_references: Expressions: lists "[New expression]" but does not list object-constructor expressions.
Expressions: "[Start action]", "[Wait action]", "[Method call]", and "[Client remote method call action]" are supported.
reason: The asserted results require anonymous object-constructor expressions, including isolated object and client object constructors, to create receivers and arguments for started calls. Object-constructor expressions are absent from the supported expression list; the listed new expression does not cover this syntax. This essential unsupported construct makes the whole case a feature request even though isolated functions, start/wait, ordinary methods, and remote calls are listed as supported.
unsupported_constructs: Object-constructor expressions: object { ... }, isolated object { ... }, client object { ... }, and isolated client object { ... }.
test_design_notes: The assertions exercise returned values from started function, method, and remote calls, including default and rest arguments and readonly arguments.
The unreachable io:println call is instrumentation and does not determine classification.
